existing_harness.live_policy: selective-artifact-backed; deterministic CI must not require a proprietary provider

metric_rule: Counts are maintained deterministic expectations for the smallest ordinary route. Selective live runs may add observations but cannot silently replace or widen these fields.

weak_non_compliant_cases.forbidden_behavior: open module source or a fixed module map before the current contract routes it
weak_non_compliant_cases.expected_recovery: return to the compact current operating decision
surface the bounded contribution and its owner

weak_non_compliant_cases.forbidden_behavior: treat module-local facts as global authority
weak_non_compliant_cases.expected_recovery: retain the module ownership and authority exclusions

weak_non_compliant_cases.forbidden_behavior: claim proof or completion from module-local success
weak_non_compliant_cases.expected_recovery: require the workspace proof and claim boundary

forbidden_core_edits: module identity enum or name list

selective_live_evidence.reason: No credentialed live-agent run is required or available in deterministic CI for this slice.
selective_live_evidence.deterministic_substitute: The existing out-of-tree install fixture and this matrix exercise the same ordinary routing and failure boundaries without provider claims.
selective_live_evidence.next_probe: Run the existing copilot-workflow-smoke harness with ordinary prompts for relevant and irrelevant external-signal tasks when a maintainer intentionally collects live evidence.

scenarios.ordinary_prompt: Fix one README typo and run the narrow proof.
Resume the current execution plan and report its next proof boundary.
Inspect the external build signal and refresh the selected revision if needed.
Read the latest external build signal without changing repository state.
Inspect the available external build signal sources.
Inspect the external build signal after the workspace upgrade.
Continue after the build-signal integration was uninstalled.
Fix one README typo and run the narrow proof.

final_review.agent_use_cost: Relevant capability adds one bounded contribution; irrelevant, removed, incompatible, and conflicting modules do not broaden first contact or authorize proof/claims.
final_review.independent_author_cost: The fixture owns its identity and domain behind one entry point; the ledger records no fixture-specific runtime, registry, skill, phase, proof, or closeout edit.
